title: Astragalus Polysaccharides Alleviate Lumbar Disc Herniation by Promoting the O-GlcNAcylation of NRF2.
authors: Tan, Hao; Xiao, Pingsen; Fang, Cao; Wang, Zhi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪多糖通过OGT介导NRF2的O-GlcNAc修饰缓解腰椎间盘突出炎症，虽含分子对接但核心为糖基化修饰与炎症通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Lumbar disc herniation (LDH) is a complex degenerative disease caused by inflammation and mechanical compression of nerve roots by the nucleus pulposus (NP). Astragalus polysaccharides (APS) have anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects. Given the regulatory role of O-GlcNAcylation in inflammation and degenerative diseases, this study aimed to explore the potential molecular regulatory mechanism of O-GlcNAcylation in the anti-inflammatory effect of APS in LDH. We established the LDH rat model to investigate the effects of APS on LDH and inflammatory response. IL-1beta-stimulated NP cells were generated, and inflammation was assessed by measuring the expression of IL-6, IL-18, and TNF-alpha with enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. The apoptosis of NP cells was analyzed by flow cytometry. The underlying mechanism was investigated by quantitative real-time PCR, co-immunoprecipitation, and molecular docking. The results indicated that APS inhibited proinflammatory cytokine expression in LDH rats and IL-1beta-induced NP cells. APS bonded to OGT and promoted its mediated-O-GlcNAcylation levels. Further, we certified that NRF2 was the target of OGT-mediated O-GlcNAcylation. Of note, the silencing of NRF2 abolished the protective effects of OGT on IL-1beta-stimulated NP cells. The mitigation effect of APS on LDH is through enhancing OGT expression to promote O-GlcNAcylation of NRF2, suggesting that O-GlcNAcylation of NRF2 is an important regulatory factor for LDH and offers a novel treatment strategy for the disease.
abstract_zh: 腰椎间盘突出症（LDH）是一种由髓核（NP）引起的炎症和神经根机械压迫所导致的复杂退行性疾病。黄芪多糖（APS）具有抗炎和免疫调节作用。鉴于O-GlcNAc修饰在炎症和退行性疾病中的调控作用，本研究旨在探讨O-GlcNAc修饰在APS抗炎作用中对LDH的潜在分子调控机制。我们建立了LDH大鼠模型，以研究APS对LDH及炎症反应的影响。生成IL-1β刺激的NP细胞，并通过酶联免疫吸附试验测量IL-6、IL-18和TNF-α的表达来评估炎症反应。通过流式细胞术分析NP细胞的凋亡情况。通过定量实时PCR、免疫共沉淀和分子对接研究其潜在机制。结果表明，APS抑制了LDH大鼠和IL-1β诱导的NP细胞中促炎细胞因子的表达。APS与OGT结合并促进其介导的O-GlcNAc修饰水平。进一步，我们证实NRF2是OGT介导的O-GlcNAc修饰的靶点。值得注意的是，NRF2的沉默消除了OGT对IL-1β刺激的NP细胞的保护作用。APS对LDH的缓解作用是通过增强OGT表达来促进NRF2的O-GlcNAc修饰，这表明NRF2的O-GlcNAc修饰是LDH的重要调控因子，并为该疾病提供了一种新的治疗策略。
